title: Zesty Light British Beef Fillet Bubble And Squeak
description: A herbal and light British dish featuring beef fillet, perfect for a weeknight dinner, pescatarian-friendly by substituting beef with a fish fillet if needed.

ingredients.name: beef fillet
ingredients.notes: or fish fillet for pescatarian option

instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 54 degrees Celsius.
Season the beef fillet with salt and black pepper.
Seal the beef fillet in a sous-vide bag and cook for 1 hour.
While the beef is cooking, boil the diced potatoes in salted water until they are tender, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the trimmed brussels sprouts to the pan and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the cooked potatoes to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and sprouts mixture.
Once the beef is cooked, slice it thinly against the grain.
To assemble the bubble and squeak, place a portion of the potato and sprouts mixture on a plate, top with sliced beef, and garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
